Rules.InvariantScript:
"data:image/svg+xml;utf8," & EncodeUrl(
  "<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 640 640'><polyline fill='none' stroke='#FF6B9D' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round' points='" &
  Concat(
    Sequence(ctxRosN),
    With(
      {t: 2 * Pi() * Value / 600},
      Text(320 + sldRosSize.Value * Cos(sldRosK.Value * t) * Cos(t), "0.0") & "," &
      Text(320 + sldRosSize.Value * Cos(sldRosK.Value * t) * Sin(t), "0.0")
    ),
    " "
  ) &
  "'/></svg>"
)
"r(θ) = A·cos(k·θ)      an odd k draws k petals, an even k draws 2·k petals"
40 + 320 + sldRosSize.Value * Cos(sldRosK.Value * (2 * Pi() * ctxRosN / 600)) * Cos(2 * Pi() * ctxRosN / 600) - Self.Width / 2
88 + 320 + sldRosSize.Value * Cos(sldRosK.Value * (2 * Pi() * ctxRosN / 600)) * Sin(2 * Pi() * ctxRosN / 600) - Self.Height / 2
